replicas.description: Number of OpenBAO replicas. HA with Raft is automatically enabled when replicas > 1. Switching between standalone (file storage) and HA (Raft storage) modes requires data migration.

resources.description: Explicit CPU and memory configuration for each OpenBAO replica. When omitted, the preset defined in `resourcesPreset` is applied.

resourcesPreset.description: Default sizing preset used when `resources` is omitted.

size.description: Persistent Volume Claim size for data storage.

storageClass.description: StorageClass used to store the data.

external.description: Enable external access from outside the cluster.

seal.description: Seal configuration. Defaults to Shamir key shares; set `type: static` for auto-unseal.

allowMigration.description: Acknowledge a seal migration. The chart refuses to change `type` on an existing instance unless this is `true`; set it only while running `bao operator unseal -migrate`, then remove it.

keyId.description: Permanent identifier of the current key. Change it whenever the key material changes; OpenBAO refuses a key whose identifier it has already seen with different material. Required when `type` is `static`.

previousKeyId.description: Identifier of the previous key. Required when `previousSecretName` is set.

previousSecretName.description: Secret holding the previous key during an n-1 key rotation.

secretName.description: Existing Secret in the release namespace whose key `key` holds the base64 text of 32 random bytes (for example `openssl rand -base64 32`). Required when `type` is `static`.

type.description: Seal type. `shamir` keeps the current behaviour; `static` enables auto-unseal from `secretName`.
